plumbing.name: Maine Internal Plumbing Code (02-395 ch. 4, adopts 2021 UPC with Maine amendments)

elsewhere: MUBEC (2021 IRC/IECC) is mandatory statewide only in municipalities with population over 4,000 that have a building code enforcement office; elsewhere it is not enforced by the state but applies as the standard in smaller towns that adopt it. Check the town.
notes: MUBEC 2021 effective 2025-04-07 per AIA Maine; State amendments to tracked keys not itemized. NEC edition for houses unconfirmed (Maine Electricians' Examining Board).
